name: Archiver
tip: Storage you volunteered for other people. A quota is a ceiling, not a target — and nothing of yours is ever evicted to make room.

children.name: quota
children.tip: Tap the quota to raise it in 5 GB steps; past 50 GB it returns to zero — revoking must be as easy as granting.

name: What's on my disk
tip: Everything being held for other people. Tap a row to drop it — a person who cannot delete it has not consented to anything.

children.name: held
children.tip: Size, whose it is, and how long we have kept it. Tap to drop.
